hypothesis: Final visible RGB plus connected-ink support can expand a uniquely seeded semantic mask without merging parents via broad paint rectangles. Source rendering already applies operation order, clipping, white occlusion and alpha; no hidden glyph is regenerated.
rule: 8-connected nonwhite components; exactly one intersecting semantic seed accepts the component for that source object. Multiple/zero owners refuse, retaining the full original raster. No nearest-parent guessing, color-based paint deletion or page-specific margins.
fixtures: Original ordered drawing operations: wide white background, white overpaint, later text after background, transparency overlapping independent objects, touching objects, unseeded isolated mark. First3 expected accept, last3 expected refuse. Opaque final RGB preserves composited color.
stop: One fixed invariant pass. Then only a labeled mechanism regression on now-seen ConvNeXt; any future new paper validation is separately registered before inspection. No retrospective generalization claim.
